title: Korea Stock Market Today, Oct 2, 2026: Optical Networking and Space Stocks Rally
content:
KOSPI closed at 7,003.74, up 0.46%, recovering from an early slide to roughly 6,940 as profit-taking after the prior day's rally met rising oil prices and won weakness; KOSDAQ closed essentially flat at 893.29, down 0.11%, as momentum cooled following its sharp gain the day before. Optical-networking and space stocks led the day's individual movers.

1. Profit-taking after the prior rally — KOSPI weak open, KOSDAQ holds up better intraday

Korean markets opened weak as profit-taking after the previous session's sharp rally — driven by Micron's earnings and strong chip export data — combined with rising global oil prices and pressure on the won. KOSPI fell to roughly 6,940 in early trading on foreign and institutional selling, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix trading range-bound as the prior day's momentum faded. KOSPI clawed back the losses to close up 0.46% at 7,003.74, while KOSDAQ held closer to flat, closing down a slight 0.11% at 893.29 after its outsized gain in the prior session.

2. Big Tech's AI infrastructure buildout — optical networking and telecom equipment stocks rally

As U.S. Big Tech companies expand AI data center investment, the volume of data that must move between GPUs and servers is surging, reviving expectations for investment in optical-communications infrastructure — fiber optics, optical transceivers, and high-speed networking. AI data centers demand far higher bandwidth and power efficiency than traditional electrical-signal connections, and the market is increasingly focused on the chain from AI investment to data-transfer bottlenecks to spending on optical networks, co-packaged optics (CPO), and optical modules. Mercury and TMC hit their daily upper limit, while Bitsam Electronics, Woori Lo, Sungho Electronics, OE Solutions, Lycom, and Wireble all rallied on the theme.

3. SpaceX's crewed Dragon docks with ISS — space and aerospace stocks rally

Shares tied to the space sector rallied after SpaceX's crewed Dragon spacecraft docked with the International Space Station roughly eight hours after launch, setting a record for the fastest crewed docking in U.S. spaceflight history. The mission, Crew-13, was NASA's 13th operational crew rotation flown by SpaceX, and its smooth execution revived expectations around the commercialization of private spaceflight and related infrastructure investment. LK Samyang, Kencoa Aerospace, HVM, and Nara Space Technology all gained on the news.

Quick FAQ

Did KOSPI finish the day weak or strong?
It opened weak, falling to roughly 6,940 on profit-taking and currency/oil-price pressure, but recovered through the session to close up 0.46% at 7,003.74.

Why did optical-networking stocks rally today?
Expanding AI data center investment from U.S. Big Tech is driving expectations for more spending on the optical infrastructure — fiber, transceivers, CPO — needed to move the resulting data traffic.

Why did SpaceX's ISS docking move Korean stocks?
The successful, record-fast crewed docking reinforced confidence in private spaceflight's reliability, reviving expectations for commercialization and related infrastructure spending that spilled into Korean space-sector names.
